# NoteBill

> NoteBill is AI-assisted invoicing software that turns rough job notes into clean, itemized invoices for freelancers, contractors, and service businesses.

NoteBill turns incomplete, messy invoice notes into a professional invoice. It structures free-form input, asks focused follow-up questions when pricing is missing instead of making silent assumptions, supports wording changes, saves invoice documents, and produces a clean print/PDF-ready result.

## Pages

- [NoteBill](https://notebill.app/): Turn job notes into invoices
- [Pricing](https://notebill.app/pricing): Free plan and NoteBill Pro pricing
- [Free Invoice Generator](https://notebill.app/free-invoice-generator): Turn rough job notes into a downloadable PDF invoice without an account
- [Contractor Estimate Template](https://notebill.app/contractor-estimate-template): Build Good / Better / Best trade quotes with deposit requests and client e-signatures
- [Materials Markup Calculator](https://notebill.app/materials-markup-calculator): Calculate parts markup vs. profit margin and send line items into an invoice
- [Help](https://notebill.app/help): Help and guidance for using NoteBill
- [Support](https://notebill.app/support): Support for NoteBill users
- [Privacy Policy](https://notebill.app/privacy): NoteBill privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://notebill.app/terms): NoteBill terms of service
